what_this_is: Step 8 capability workstream, step 1: the Fetch skybox caveat in examples/results/step8/capability/per_world_model_arrays.md section 2(ii), measured. The packet INFERRED from fetch.py:653-654 and fetch.py:763 that the skybox lives in the MuJoCo-baked plate and is therefore reachable by a texel substitution, contradicting the reason recorded at fetch.py:589-592 ('mujoco_warp uploads textures when a render context is built, so a per-value skybox is one render context per value'). This probe settles it.
method: Local, /Users/samib/se8-fetch-venv, MUJOCO_GL=glfw. FetchEnv CONSTRUCTION is blocked locally by the numpy 2.5.3 + mujoco 3.12 upstream defect (gymnasium_robotics set_joint_qpos asserts on the compiled joint type), so the probe compiles the four scenes' MJCFs directly and renders them through mujoco.Renderer at the family's DEFAULT_CAMERA_CONFIG free camera at 480 px -- the same raster FetchBase._bake_plate takes. Arm 1 substitutes the skybox texels in place and calls mjr_uploadTexture on the renderer's own GL context. Arm 2 recompiles the scene through MjSpec with the MJCF skybox texture's rgb1=rgb2=the same colour.
findings: The skybox IS in the baked plate. Substituting its texels moves 171,620 of 230,400 px (74.5%) on push/pick_and_place/reach and 143,275 (62.2%) on slide. The packet's inference is right and the reason recorded at fetch.py:589-592 is wrong: no second render context is needed, because the delivered skybox pixels never come from the mujoco_warp pass at all.

The substitution is the same operation swm performs. stable_worldmodel's own background.color (stable_worldmodel/envs/gymnasium_robotics/fetch.py:400-430) does NOT recompile either: it writes (bg*255).astype(uint8) flat over the skybox texels and calls mjr_uploadTexture. Same truncation rule as _plate_texels.quantise, independently.

Against a full RECOMPILE the substitution differs by at most 1/255 on <=5,903 of 230,400 px (<=2.6%), and by 0 px at the two probe values whose channels quantise exactly. That residual is MuJoCo's own gradient compiler rounding where swm truncates -- it is the recompile arm that differs from swm, not the substitution.

NEW BLOCKER, and it is not a capability gap. swm's operation FLATTENS the skybox, and the Fetch skybox is a 16-colour GRADIENT (measured: 16 unique texel colours over 6,144 texels, rgb1 .44 .85 .56 to rgb2 .46 .87 .58). So no flat-fill leaf value reproduces our registered default appearance, and a masked two-colour substitution (the DM Control shape) does not reproduce swm's flat sky. Offering the leaf would therefore move this family's DEFAULT frame, which is a frozen pixel oracle on the Step-4/Step-7 corpora -- a re-freeze, which Step-8 plan section 19 forbids without Sami's approval. Escalated; background.color stays `partial` with its residual re-stated.
Default restore is byte-identical on all four scenes after every probe value, so the substitution leaks nothing across bakes.
